$comment: Per-contract showcase-navigation decisions read by scripts/build-joomla-showcase-nav.mjs. hide/keep name a menu item by key (+ path and menutype, checked), optionally its whole subtree, or a whole menutype; every entry carries the reason. A subtree or menutype hide never takes a working screen inside it (users, smart search, tags, search, contact): such an item stays and is listed unresolved until an entry names it by its own key and reason. Contracts not listed use the automatic rule alone.
